cards.card_text: And God is serious: anyone who doesn't humble himself must be cut off from his people, and anyone who does any work on this day, God says He will destroy.
cards.verse_text: On this day you are not to do any work, for it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God. If anyone does not humble himself on this day, he must be cut off from his people. I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on this day.
